notes: OneMDollar is implemented in src/OneMDollar.sol. Its constructor takes liquidityPool_, feeRecipient_, poolManager_ in that order and mints the entire fixed supply once to msg.sender. The first two arguments are ABI-encoded address words; fees go to the requester's remainderTo address. The configured taxable endpoint is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001001, the address used in the accepted tests. No production taxable-pool address was supplied, and the accepted tree contains no separate pool implementation or evidence of a deployed venue at that address. This manifest deploys only OneMDollar. The token charges floor(amount * 9900 / 10000) on transfers into or out of that configured endpoint, including transfers between that endpoint and the launch PoolManager. Transfers that do not involve the configured taxable endpoint are untaxed; the launch's v4 pool therefore has no 99% token transfer tax. The constructor rejects using the launch PoolManager as the taxable endpoint. The taxable endpoint, fee recipient and manager are immutable. There are no initialization calls, further minting or administrative setters. The 3000 pool fee is the separate 0.3% AMM fee, with tick spacing 60. initialPrice is the accepted integration tests' 2^96 reference value, for provenance only; the deployer derives the actual opening price from initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply and currency ordering. A functional separate taxable venue at the configured address is not established by this manifest.
